title: Safety and Efficacy of PMI-150 (Intranasal Ketamine) for the Treatment of Breakthrough Pain in Cancer Patients
brief_summary: To assess the safety and efficacy of PMI-150 (Intranasal Ketamine) as an analgesic for the treatment of breakthrough pain in cancer patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* at least 18 years of age
* Patients requiring around-the-clock opioids for pain due to cancer and with a history of experiencing episodes of breakthrough pain

Exclusion Criteria:

* under 18 years
* non-cancer pain
* allergy to ketamine
